wu: Play 'Future Predictions Charades': teacher writes 'will/won't' predictions on slips (e.g., 'It will rain tomorrow'), students act them out while others guess using 'Will it...?'.
wuAlt: Alternative 1: 'Prediction Relay' - teams race to write 'will/won't' sentences on the board about the teacher's prompts.
Alternative 2: 'Maybe, Probably' TPR - teacher gestures 'maybe' (shrug) or 'probably' (nod) for students to repeat.
pres: Show flashcards of Moroccan holidays (Eid, Green March) and ask 'What will happen next Eid?'. Model 'It will probably be sunny' and 'Maybe people will visit family'. Check understanding with 'Thumbs up/down' for true/false sentences.
presAlt: Alternative 1: Use a short story about a boy planning Labour Day with 'will/won't' predictions.
Alternative 2: Display a weather forecast and elicit 'It will probably be hot'.
prac: Play 'Prediction Bingo': students draw 4 grid squares and write predictions (e.g., 'I will pass my test'). Teacher reads statements; students mark off matches and shout 'Bingo!' when complete.
pracAlt: Alternative 1: 'Sentence Scramble' - pairs reorder word cards to make correct 'will/won't' sentences.
Alternative 2: 'Chain Predictions' - students add to a class prediction circle (e.g., 'Aicha will... and then...').
ls: Listen to a 1-minute dialogue about Independence Day predictions (e.g., 'There will be fireworks'). Students tick predictions they hear from a list.
re: Play 'Stand Up If...': teacher calls out predictions (e.g., 'Stand up if you will eat couscous tonight'), students stand/sit to respond.
prod: Write and swap 5 quiz questions about will for predictions (e.g., 'Will Morocco win the World Cup?'). Partners answer with 'Yes, probably' or 'No, maybe not'.
rw: Read a short text about future tech in Morocco and rank predictions from 'most likely' to 'least likely'. Write 2 sentences about one prediction using 'will' or 'probably'.
st: Read a story 'Aisha's Eid Predictions' with will/won't, then close with 'Today we learned to make predictions with will. Great work, class! Thank you!'
g: Draw 'will/won't' scenarios for others to guess
Add 'will' sentences to a shared story
Ask peers 'Will you...?' and tally responses
diff: Fast finishers: write 3 'unlikely' predictions using 'won't probably'.
Support: use sentence frames 'It will probably...' and 'Maybe it will...'.
hw: Interview a family member: 'What will you do next weekend?' and note answers.
Write 5 predictions about your city in 10 years using 'will' and 'probably'.
Watch a 1-minute weather forecast and write 3 predictions.
tip: Use local events (like Green March) to make predictions relevant, and encourage students to justify guesses with 'because' to build longer turns.
